Tom — thanks for sending these over and welcome. Quick clarifications from our side:

- Redwood's standard vendor onboarding for non-US entities requires a W-8BEN-E plus either a local tax registration document or a recent bank statement that clearly shows the company legal name and account number. The W-8 you sent looks completed but our finance team notes the payee name on the bank statement is slightly abbreviated.
- For US withholding: because Redwood is a US payer but services are delivered from the UK, withholding depends on treaty applicability and the W-8BEN-E claims. Our Tax & Compliance team will need the tax treaty claim line completed (Part III) and acceptable proof of UK tax residency (letter from HMRC or a UK tax registration cert).
- Payment rails: Redwood prefers ACH for USD payments and wire (SWIFT/IBAN) for GBP/EUR. For wire we need: Beneficiary legal name (exact match to vendor legal entity), IBAN, SWIFT/BIC, and a correspondent bank if routing requires USD conversion.

Could you please: 1) re-send a bank statement with the exact legal name (or a bank confirmation letter), and 2) confirm whether you intend to receive USD or GBP for Redwood invoices. If GBP, we'll route via SWIFT. If you want USD and do not have a US bank, our AP team will instruct a correspondent bank route.

Looping in Marcus (procurement) and Karthik (vendor operations) to expedite PO creation once we have the missing pieces.

Best,
Monica Patel
Vendor Onboarding Lead | Procurement
Redwood Inference
